notes: Polymeter Glitch Drums XFX - XFX MODE with the DRUM SEQUENCER on XFX output. Lanes loop at different lengths (15, 13, 16, 14, 11, 7, 9, 10, 12, 5, 32, 6 and 8 steps) so the groove keeps phasing and never repeats exactly: classic IDM polymeter at 150 BPM, with stuttering repeat-envelope hats and reversed glitch percussion.
